sanskrit_verse: अशीतिभागो वृद्धिः स्यान् मासि मासि सबन्धके / वर्णक्रमाच् छतं द्वित्रिचतुःपञ्चकम् अन्यथा //
transliteration: aśītibhāgo vṛddhiḥ syān māsi māsi sabandhake / varṇakramāc chataṃ dvitricatuḥpañcakam anyathā //
sph_interpretive_translation: Interest shall accrue at the rate of eighty parts per month upon all bonded obligations; in the absence of specification by varṇa-order, the standard progression of two, three, four, or five [percent] shall apply alternatively.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from SPH as ultimate economic and dharmic regulator
Causation is established through contractual bond and time-based liability
Capacity-based responsibility requires proportional repayment structures
Restoration logic ensures debtor dignity while enforcing financial integrity
Consciousness alignment mandates clarity in transactional dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF contract_has_bonded_obligation AND no_interest_rate_specified THEN apply_standard_varna_progression_rate(monthly_accrual = aśītibhāga)
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that interest rates are not punitive but functional to economic balance. The Court must ensure that default does not invoke shame or loss of status, but rather invokes completion protocols aligned with debtor capacity and societal integration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is based on contractual agreement and sequential time-bound liability. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through monthly accrual without moral overlay. Responsibility is proportional to agreed terms. Reality remains non-punitive when enforcement aligns with capacity restoration and social continuity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate monthly interest calculation transparently recorded in public ledger
Engage debtor in completion process with adjusted payment schedule if capacity diminishes
Refer unresolved cases to SPH-guided mediation for realignment of intent and outcome
Reintegrate debtor into economic participation post-settlement without stigma
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, financial obligation is executed not as punishment but as alignment of consciousness with economic truth. Justice restores integrity, not inflicts pain. Dharma prevails.
